Our analysis

Of the 59 hatchbacks in our comparison, the Honda Civic Type R is the 5th most expensive to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €31,266 over 5 years, 57% of the total.

At a real consumption of 9.2 L/100 km, every 100 km costs about €16.51 in fuel.

FAQ

How much does a Honda Civic Type R cost per month?

About €908 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.726 per km.

Which DGT label does the Honda Civic Type R have?

The C label.
